purpose: Read-only city-specific source discovery and bounded access review; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: The Municipalidad Provincial de Trujillo’s PLANDET unit is responsible for maintaining the Trujillo cadastral information system and public cartographic geoviewer; the first-party viewer lists cadastral-lot tables. This verifies a city-local cadastre and map service, but the public feature schema and data properties are not constrained by the client. The official public viewer exposes a table-backed GeoJSON route without a field-selection parameter. Its property schema is not published, so a bounded query might return unreviewed fields. No feature request or geometry was made.

officialEvidence.observation: Municipal organizational regulation assigns the PLANDET Geomatics and Cadastre subunit to maintain Trujillo’s cadastral information system, maintain the city geoviewer, and issue cadastral-code certificates for Trujillo district.
First-party municipal announcement says the public Geovisor Cartográfico includes lot information, zoning and other geographic layers for the Trujillo metropolitan/provincial area.
Current PLANDET page identifies the municipal unit responsible for district cadastre, property formalization and territorial planning; it links the public viewer.
Public map shell publishes table names including `s25_lote_cata`, `s26_lote_cata`, `s27_lote_cata`, `s32_lote_cata`, `s33_lote_cata`, and `sector13_lote_catastral`.
Viewer client fetches `api.php?tabla={name}` and appends a bounding-box parameter when supplied. It provides no field-selection parameter; no feature request or geometry was made.
Municipal performance document reports urban cadastral updates and maintenance of the PLANDET geoviewer; it does not define a safe feature schema.

routes: GET `api.php?tabla={name}`; viewer can append `bbox={west,south,east,north}`. No field projection or schema allowlist found.
Published polygon table names include `s25_lote_cata`, `s26_lote_cata`, `s27_lote_cata`, `s32_lote_cata`, `s33_lote_cata`, and `sector13_lote_catastral`.
viewer.notes: The route returns GeoJSON table content without a field allowlist; the map contains both cadastral and administrative/land-use layers and ancillary document interactions. Feature query omitted pending an explicit safe properties schema.

serviceTrace.notes: Whether the lot layers return only geometry/safe IDs or include sensitive cadastral/property attributes; coverage scope of each lot-table layer and WUP-point inclusion are unverified.
